audit_scope: Current upstream repository metadata, immutable revision, root license text where available, targeted source-release checks, and public Hugging Face model-card metadata. This is not a reproduction or numerical-fidelity certificate.

redistribution_policy.permitted_with_notice: A permissive license was identified. Preserve upstream copyright, full license and any NOTICE; separately check per-file code, weights and data.
redistribution_policy.restricted: Additional conditions apply, including noncommercial/no-derivatives/custom terms or copyleft source-distribution duties. This is not a blanket claim that copying is forbidden.
redistribution_policy.unknown: No sufficient permission has been verified; do not infer a right to redistribute from public availability.

Pinned source calls CUDA directly and needs external pretrained MedSyn weights and report embeddings. No upstream environment, code or model weights were installed or executed by this update.

The root source-code license is Apache-2.0; this does not settle the separate terms of all bundled dependencies, model checkpoints or datasets. No third-party code or clinical data is redistributed here.

Conference page dates the work to MICCAI 2026; repository HEAD is dated 2026-09-25 and the arXiv record is dated 2026-10-07. The README BibTeX uses 2027; do not treat that inconsistent field as a new model release.
